name: year
description: Year the assessment area was reported for

name: respondent_id
description: Respondent identifier assigned by the institution's supervisory agency; unique only together with agency and year, and not an RSSD

name: agency_id
description: Supervisory agency that assigned the respondent identifier: occ, frs, fdic, or ots for the Office of Thrift Supervision, which was abolished in 2011 and appears only up to 2010

name: rssd_id
description: RSSD identifier of the reporting institution, taken from the CRA transmittal sheet for the same respondent, agency and year; the join key to institution, call_report_item and holding_company

name: county_id
description: Five-digit county FIPS code, the state code followed by the county code

name: msa_md_id
description: Metropolitan statistical area or metropolitan division code as defined by OMB

name: census_tract_id
description: Eleven-digit census tract identifier, the county FIPS code followed by the six-digit tract number
observations: Not linked to the census tract directory: the file spans four decennial tract vintages (1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020 boundaries in different years) and the source does not restate earlier years onto current boundaries, so a single-vintage foreign key would be wrong for most of the series.

name: assessment_area_id
description: Assessment area number the institution assigned to the area
observations: NA for tracts outside any assessment area.

name: is_partial_county
description: Whether the assessment area covers only part of the county, 1 for yes

name: is_split_county
description: Whether the county is split across more than one assessment area, 1 for yes

name: population_classification
description: Whether the county has fewer or more than 500,000 residents

name: tract_income_group
description: Income group of the census tracts the lending is grouped into, as a share of area median family income
